verdict: Ads have been paused 15 days; the contract renewal unlocks restart.
narrative: All 39 leads this period arrived in the first 13 days of the window, before August 6 — paid ads have been fully paused since then, and no new leads have come in during those 15 days. Ad performance was not the reason for the pause: when campaigns were running, your cost per lead averaged $24.44, which sits within the normal historical range. The account resumes as soon as the contract extension is signed, with Meta campaigns ready to go live immediately after. In parallel, Google Business Profile visibility dropped sharply this week and is being watched closely to ensure that organic channel recovers alongside paid.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all from the first 13 days before ads paused
cost per lead while campaigns were running — within normal range
consecutive days with no ad spend, paused pending contract renewal

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile actions fell over 90% week-over-week, removing the organic lead buffer while paid is also paused.
watch_item.fix: A consistent GBP posting cadence is being stood up and is scheduled to go live by end of September to rebuild organic visibility.
